entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I assist you today?
Hi Charlie. I... um... I need to return something. I bought the VeloBand Pulse and I'm just completely lost with it.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your order number to start?
Sure, it's VF-8819-25. It's just... I really expected more from it. The whole thing is so confusing to navigate.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... VF-8819-25. Got it. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse about 12 days ago, on December 31st. Is that correct?
Yes, that's it. I've tried everything. I read the user manual cover to cover, but it's just so hard to use. The menus don't make any sense. Can't you just help me return it?
I understand your frustration. Of course, let me just double-check our return policy for you. Please hold for one moment.
Alright, thank you for waiting. I've confirmed our policy, and yes, you're all set. We accept returns on all items within 90 days of delivery.
Oh! Really? So I can send it back for a refund?
Absolutely. Since you're only on day 12, you're well within that 90-day window. I'm approving the return now and I'll email you a prepaid shipping label immediately.
Wow, okay. That's... a huge relief. Thank you so much, Charlie! I was so worried this would be a whole big thing.
Not a problem at all, happy I could make it easy for you. You should see that email in the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for your help!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
